issues.description: The solution's set_pixel implementation violates the subroutine contract specified in the problem statement. The problem requires that set_pixel receives x in EAX, y in EBX and RGB in ECX and that no registers other than EAX are changed by the routine. The solution's set_pixel uses and modifies EDI (it executes `or edi, edi` and branches on it) but does not save/restore EDI, so it clobbers a register that must be preserved. This contradicts the problem description and would confuse students (and break callers that expect registers other than EAX to be preserved).
issues.suggested_fix: Adjust the solution implementation so it adheres to the specified calling/side-effect contract: do not rely on or modify EDI (remove the alpha-channel check that uses EDI), or save and restore any registers you use (e.g., push edi at entry and pop edi before ret). Prefer computing x*4 via shifts (SHL EAX,2) or using saved temporaries and ensure all registers except EAX are restored before returning. This preserves the intended design and avoids confusing students.
